text:
Married A CM's Son At 24, Widowed In 11 Days: The Untold Tragedy Of Leena Chandavarkar
Curated By :
Last Updated:
A top film star marrying into a political dynasty, it seemed like a fairytale. But just 11 days later, tragedy struck, shattering Leena Chandavarkar’s dreams of a happy future
1/6
There are many painful stories behind the grandeur we see on the silver screen. The personal lives of many famous actors and actresses who have made a name for themselves in cinema often hold tragic tales. This is the story of one such actress whose world turned upside down just 11 days after marrying the son of a Chief Minister. (News18 Tamil)
2/6
Leena Chandavarkar, a popular actress who rose to fame in Bollywood during the 1970s and 1980s, was born into a family of army personnel in Karnataka. She made her acting debut with the film Maa Ka Meet in 1968, opposite Vinod Khanna, who later became a superstar. The film was a superhit at the box office. (News18 Tamil)
ADVERTISEMENT
3/6
Leena Chandavarkar went on to act with top stars like Rajesh Khanna and Dilip Kumar, quickly rising to become one of the leading actresses of her time. At the peak of her career, she met Siddharth Bandodkar, who came from a politically prominent family. (News18 Tamil)
4/6
The two fell in love and soon tied the knot. Leena Chandavarkar was just 24 at the time. Siddharth Bandodkar was the son of Goa’s first Chief Minister, Dayanand Bandodkar. A top film star marrying into a political dynasty, it all seemed like a fairytale. Leena Chandavarkar stepped into her new life with dreams of a happy future. But fate had something tragic in store. (News18 Tamil)
ADVERTISEMENT
5/6
Just 11 days after their wedding, Siddharth Bandodkar tragically died. He was cleaning his gun when it accidentally discharged, killing him on the spot. Leena Chandavarkar returned to her mother’s home, heartbroken. To make matters worse, people blamed her misfortune for Siddharth Bandodkar’s death. Within less than two weeks of marriage, she was labelled a widow and was harshly judged by society. (News18 Tamil)
6/6
Eventually, she returned to films. However, her comeback film Bairaag failed at the box office. Around this time, she came into contact with legendary singer and actor Kishore Kumar. Kishore Kumar was 20 years older than her, and had already been divorced three times. His family strongly opposed the match. Still, the two went ahead and got married. Today, she is 74 years old and despite all the ups and downs in her life, she remains a symbol of strength and resilience in the face of personal tragedy. (News18 Tamil)
